summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload on npm install
details: The package's `preinstall` script (`node setup.mjs`) is obfuscator.io-style obfuscated (identifiers such as `_0x488df8`, dictionary-object string indirection) and, on `npm install`, downloads the Bun runtime from `github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<arch>.zip`, unpacks it to a temp directory, chmods the Bun binary executable, and then invokes it via `execFileSync` to run the locally shipped `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB Bun-compiled CJS bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) with heavy control-flow and string-array obfuscation (rotator function `WV8StW`, large mixed literal decoding array `n7gIxM`). The declared purpose of the package is a Cypress selector-helpers library, which has no legitimate need for a Bun-compiled binary blob or a Bun runtime. The alternate-runtime execution vector — fetching a separate language runtime and executing an opaque, obfuscated payload under it — evades Node-based supply-chain scanners; the obfuscation of the wrapper script itself hides trivial download-and-exec operations. The payload runs automatically at install time under the downloaded Bun runtime.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
